_comment: temporal-workflow.md, 'Subagents are full agents'. A clearly-Deliberate top-level task; turn:1 spawns a subagent handed a clearly-complex sub-task. The subagent runs ClassifyRequest + RoutingWorkflow itself and, being Deliberate, opens its OWN single-turn task-run (turns.plan_id == its own turn_id <turn:1>:sub:1, openedFresh in turn.go) — one reason-act loop. At the subagent turn's end dispatchRecordSkill fires over its trajectory.

message.content: Have a subagent run a full security audit of the auth module while the main line handles the API cleanup, then reconcile the two before we ship.

scripted_model_responses.content: Delegating the audit to a subagent.

arguments.prompt: Do a thorough security audit of the authentication module: check for injection, broken authentication and session handling, secrets committed in code, and missing rate limiting on the login path. Produce a prioritized findings report with severity for each issue.

scripted_model_responses.content: Audit complete — 3 findings: 1 critical (no login rate limit), 2 medium. Prioritized report attached.
The subagent found a critical rate-limit gap on the login path plus two medium issues; folding the critical item into the API cleanup now.
